operational_activities.name: ValidateBatteryAndPowerOnRbf2
operational_activities.doc: Verify 12S2P battery 49.0-50.0 V, confirm RBF #1 covers removed and rear prop folded, and pull UAV Power RBF #2 to energize main bus while ESAD RBF #3 remains installed (GAP-05, GAP-06).

operational_activities.name: CommandPusherThrottleAndReadEscTelem
operational_activities.doc: Issue PWM throttle command from Power Meter to IBEX160 ESC and bridge UART RPM, temperature, voltage, and current back onto CAN 1.

operational_activities.name: DistributeRegulatedPowerRails
operational_activities.doc: Regulate 8.0 V servo, 12.0 V radio, 14.0 V ESAD (GAP-01), and sensor/gimbal rails from 970.0 cm DC trunk; isolate ESAD rail on irreversible Power Off ESAD command.

operational_activities.name: MonitorBingoEnergyReserve
operational_activities.doc: Enforce 0.20 statutory Bingo reserve ratio across 5400.0 s endurance and trigger RTL upon reserve floor or main bus sag below 36.0 V.

operational_activities.name: ExecuteSimplexRtaEnvelopeCheck
operational_activities.doc: Software-resident ASTM F3269-17 Simplex RTA on Cube orange+: clamps dive speed <= 55.0 m/s (<= 80.0 m/s VNE), reacts to ESAD bus faults, and commands RTL on geofence/battery/GCS timeout.

operational_activities.name: RunPitotAndMagPreflightCheck
operational_activities.doc: Validate calm-air pitot reading <= 3.0 m/s, indirect airflow check >= 10.0 m/s, and both mRo RM3100 magnetometers online on CAN 2.

operational_activities.name: SwitchToGnssDeniedDeadReckoning
operational_activities.doc: Transition Cube orange+ navigation to INS/DR fallback using RM3100 dual mag/baro and SKYE2 pitot upon GPS Failsafe or operator Disable GNSS command.

operational_activities.name: SuperviseEsadOcMasterCycle
operational_activities.doc: Execute RPI CM5004032 100 Hz RS-485 EXCHANGE polling (CRC-16 XModem, <= 5.0 ms reply, <= 10.0 ms timeout) and gate DSC_IN1 1 kHz 2-pulse hardware arming strictly to Arm Stage 2.

operational_activities.name: ActuateTailAndWingSurfaces
operational_activities.doc: Mix pitch/yaw skid-turn onto tail fins #1-#4 (CAN 1) and active roll stabilization onto wings #5-#8 (CAN 2) over 8.0 V EPS rail.

operational_activities.name: ExecuteEsadBootAndPbit
operational_activities.doc: Receive 0xB0 WELCOME from Artron ESAD, query 0x13 VERSION and 0x11 PBIT, and verify bit 12 internal HV < 50.0 V while RBF #3 UMB (< 0.5 Ohm) remains installed (GAP-06).

operational_activities.name: TransitionEsadArmingSequence
operational_activities.doc: Execute STANAG 4187 barrier gating: power-before-pull RBF #3 removal -> SS1 launch accel -> SS2 Safe Distance Exceed == 1 (GAP-07) -> Arm Stage 2 DSC_IN1 (1 kHz, 2 pulses) -> 0x12 HIGHVOLTAGE charge (0-1800 V).

operational_activities.name: CommandEsadAbortAndSelfDestruct
operational_activities.doc: Execute >= 5.0 s ESAD self-destruct hold + Slide-to-Confirm, irreversible Power Off ESAD, or Disarm ESAD On GCS Timeout via 0x10 EXCHANGE Abort bits.

operational_activities.name: AcquireAndTrackTerminalTarget
operational_activities.doc: Stabilize Nighthawk2UZ gimbal (1280x720 Day/Thermal, X40 zoom) and hold Trip6 auto-tracker lock for 2.0-5.0 s; command Abort Engaging if airspeed > 55.0 m/s.

operational_activities.name: RebootGimbalAndBridgeEthernet
operational_activities.doc: Execute in-flight Reboot Gimbal command over ETH Switch if Nighthawk2UZ / Trip6 video freezes while keeping external interface lid locked.

operational_activities.name: ChargePl40CompressorWithUvloCheck
operational_activities.doc: Charge PL-40 air tank to 13.0-14.0 bar (<= 8.0 min, 0.05 bar hysteresis) while monitoring 18.0 V Makita BL1860B packs for <= 14.5 V UVLO cutoff and >= 16.0 V (5.0 s) restart.

operational_activities.name: ExecuteLaunchGoNoGoAndDualTrigger
operational_activities.doc: Verify 13.0-14.0 bar pressure, <= 17.0 kg MTOW (<= 30.0 kg rail limit), <= 12.0 m/s ground headwind, <= 25.0 m/s exit limit (GAP-03), red safety pin pull, Main Valve 4 open, and simultaneous >= 2.0 s dual firing hold.

operational_activities.name: DepressurizeAndScrubPl40Launcher
operational_activities.doc: Execute GAP-SCRUB SAFE_SCRUB_ABORT: shut Main Valve 4, bleed pneumatic tank safely, reinstall carriage red safety pin, and command UAV ESAD irreversible Power Off / RBF #3 reinsertion before RBF #2 disconnect.

operational_activities.name: AuthenticateOperatorAndCalibrateRotator
operational_activities.doc: Enforce Pilot/Payload/Launch Assistant >= 8 char login, ESD grounding touch, >= 10.0 m radio separation, and Antenna Rotator calibration BEFORE touching UAV.

operational_activities.name: ExportTargetReport5wCff
operational_activities.doc: Format and export 5W / Call For Fire (CFF) targeting data from SwarmC2 to ATAK, SitaWare HQ, or DELTA.

operational_scenarios.name: UC_02_VerifyPreflightPowerAndBit
operational_scenarios.objective: "Guarantee main bus 49.0-50.0 V, zero premature ESAD RBF #3 removal fault (GAP-06), and healthy avionics/propulsion BIT before PL-40 rail arming."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_03_MonitorFlightEnvelopeAndSimplexRta
operational_scenarios.objective: "Maintain inner-loop aerodynamic stability and automatically abort or clamp dive trajectories exceeding safety thresholds."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_04_ExecuteGnssDeniedAndLostLinkFailsafe
operational_scenarios.objective: "Transition seamlessly to RM3100/SKYE2 dead-reckoning and execute Disarm ESAD On GCS Timeout + RTL on sustained C2 loss."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_05_TrackAndEngageTargetWithEoIr
operational_scenarios.objective: "Achieve <= 0.5 m terminal accuracy while enforcing <= 55.0 m/s gimbal saturation safety abort."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_06_SuperviseEsadArmAndDetonation
operational_scenarios.objective: "Guarantee zero premature HV output (< 50.0 V PBIT) and strictly gated detonation only after SS1, SS2, DSC_IN1, and IRQ_L / OC Trigger."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_01_ExecutePl40RailLaunch
operational_scenarios.objective: "Achieve safe rail exit velocity (~23.0 m/s at 17.0 kg, <= 25.0 m/s limit) with zero electrical umbilical wires and clean onboard SS1 accel trigger."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_07_ManageGroundC2RotatorAndDataExport
operational_scenarios.objective: "Maintain resilient 4.4-5.0 GHz C2 tracking across OMNI/DIR/200.0 m fiber paths and interoperable tactical reporting."

operational_scenarios.name: UC_08_ExecuteSafeScrubAndHangfireRecovery
operational_scenarios.objective: "Eliminate stored pneumatic and ordnance energy safely prior to crew approach after any launch abort or hangfire."

operational_nodes.name: Avenger5V25IntegratedSystem
operational_nodes.doc: Root integrated Avenger 5 (Avenger V2.5 / ASTK A5 V2.5 + ELI PL-40 + SwarmC2) composition instantiating all 14 real part defs with zero fake RTA box and strictly mechanical PL-40 launch interface.

operational_nodes.name: MainBatteryAndFuseUnit
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-002 & BOM-AV-003: Removable 12S2P Li metal BEI maximus20 pack with QR/ID match and 200.0 A inline automotive fuse. Anchored to 36.0-50.4 V and 49.0-50.0 V pre-flight check (GAP-05).

operational_nodes.name: PowerMeterAndRbfSwitch
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-004 & BOM-AV-005: Integrated V/I Power Meter and main switch gated by UAV Power RBF Key #2 (XT60E-F). Bridges ESC UART telemetry onto CAN 1 and drives 970.0 cm trunk to EPS.

operational_nodes.name: ElectricPropulsionUnit
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-001, BOM-AV-006, BOM-AV-007, BOM-AV-008, BOM-AV-025: Avenger V2.5 X-wing pusher airframe envelope, IBEX160 ESC, AXI 5345/16 HD GOLD LINE V3 BLDC motor, rear folding prop, and RBF #1 covers/strap.

operational_nodes.name: ElectronicPowerSystemEps
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-009 & BOM-AV-026: DC/DC Converters, Load Switches, and MCU on CAN 1. Converts 36.0-50.4 V trunk to 8.0 V servos, 12.0 V radio, 14.0 V ESAD (GAP-01 zero brownout margin), pitot/mag/gimbal rails, and Optional RnD 2x 50.0 V lines (disabled on production).

operational_nodes.name: FlightControllerCubeOrangePlus
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-010: Cube orange+ primary autopilot / INS / EKF2 with CAN 1, CAN 2, 4x Serial, and USB Ext behind lockable lid. Hosts software ASTM F3269-17 Simplex RTA monitor and failsafe statecharts (ZERO standalone RTA hardware box).

operational_nodes.name: CompanionComputeRpiCm5
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-011: RPI CM5004032 companion mission computer (OC Master). Bridges SwarmC2 IP over ETH, communicates with Cube orange+ over Serial, and supervises Artron ESAD over 115200 bps 100 Hz CRC-16 XModem RS-485 plus DSC_IN1 1 kHz 2-pulse arm GPIO.

operational_nodes.name: NavigationAndAirDataSuite
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-014..017: Septentrio Asterx-m3 pro RTK GNSS + Talysman TW3972EXF antenna on Serial, plus 2x mRo RM3100 dual mag/baro and heated CUAV SKYE2 pitot on CAN 2 series daisy-chain. Supports Disable GNSS INS/DR fallback.

operational_nodes.name: DroneCanSurfaceActuation
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-018..020: 4x HV6160-DroneCAN tail ruddervator servos (#1-#4) on CAN 1 (4x 120.0 cm stubs) plus 4x HV6160-DroneCAN wing roll servos (#5-#8) on CAN 2 series daisy-chain via CAN/power splitter PCB on 8.0 V EPS rail.

operational_nodes.name: OnboardEthernetAndC2RadioUnit
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-012, BOM-AV-013, BOM-AV-021, BOM-AV-022: Internal ETH Switch + External Interface Board (USB/ETH behind lockable lid) + DTC 4.4-5.0 GHz AES-256 FHSS Radio (2.0 W / 2x 1.0 W, 8.0-17.0 V from 12.0 V EPS rail, 60.0/90.0 km RLOS) + 2x MPSL4400 antennas.

operational_nodes.name: EoIrSeekerAndTrackerUnit
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-AV-023 & BOM-AV-024: Nighthawk2UZ 2-axis stabilized gimbal (1280x720 Day/Thermal, X40 zoom, P -45..+135 deg, Y/R +/-165 deg) + Trip6 camera compute (Power+HDMI, ETH, Serial to Cube orange+).

operational_nodes.name: ArtronEsadAndSensorUnit
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-ORD-001..005: Artron ESAD (AB00-0054-01AA-0005, STANAG 4187, MIL-STD-461, 3x M3 75 mm BCD) + ESAD Sensor Board (2x M2, J102->J1 5V0/DIST_COMM1_2/ORed IRQ_L) + Warhead Holder (5.0 kg max, 4.98 +/- 0.02 kg tested, CG 30.57 +/- 1.00, 173.00, 1.5 mm HEX) + RBF #3 UMB (< 0.5 Ohm @ 20 mA) + J401 (0-1800 V, < 50.0 V PBIT safe).

operational_nodes.name: Pl40PneumaticLauncher
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-LCH-001..005: ELI PL-40 Rev 2.6 pneumatic rail catapult (5.0 m / 4938.0 mm rail, 12.0 deg elev, 13.0-14.0 bar launch, 16.0 bar aux PCP, 30.0 kg max MTOW, <= 25.0 m/s exit / ~23.0 m/s at 17.0 kg, 2x Makita BL1860B 18.0 V 6000 mAh / 14.5 V UVLO, red safety pin, Main Valve 4, >= 2.0 s dual switch, ZERO electrical/CAN wire to UAV).

operational_nodes.name: SwarmC2OperatorConsole
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-GCS-001: SwarmC2 C2 software on Windows 11 rugged tablet with Pilot/Payload/Launch Assistant role auth (>= 8 char), 24 char mission name max, 50.0-3000.0 m altitude slider (250.0 m step), 300.0 m loiter min, 2.0 min telemetry timeout, 105.0 s GCS failsafe baseline, 5.0 s ESAD self-destruct hold, and 5W/CFF export to ATAK/SitaWare HQ/DELTA.

operational_nodes.name: GroundRfStationAndAntennaTracker
operational_nodes.doc: BOM-GCS-002..006: DTC 4.4-5.0 GHz Ground Radio Box (2.0 W, 60.0/90.0 km RLOS), Directional Antenna Rotator (Auto Follow + 0.5 deg step, calibrated BEFORE touching UAV), MARS 23 dBi DIR + OMNI antennas, optional 200.0 m fiber spool, >= 10.0 m crew/UAV separation, and Transport Box ESD grounding point.
